functionalRequirement: System shall display a confirmation popup after the user fills out the form and clicks the submit button, saving the information to the database for further processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must capture and save 100% of form data fields for all valid form submissions without data loss.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures that all user-entered information is completely and accurately preserved for further processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The confirmation popup must clearly display a unique submission reference number and provide a summary of submitted information to allow users to verify their input.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users confirm their submission and provides reassurance about the successful data capture.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The confirmation popup must appear within 500 milliseconds of form submission, with database saving completed in less than 2 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures a responsive user experience during form submission and data processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must implement a retry mechanism that allows resubmission of form data in case of initial submission failure, with a maximum of 3 automatic retry attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides resilience in case of temporary network or database connection issues.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All form data must be encrypted during transmission and at rest using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive user information during storage and transmission.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The form submission and confirmation process must be implemented as a separate, reusable module with clear interface definitions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for easier future modifications and potential reuse across different form types.

functionalRequirement: User will choose from options including searching for their issue, chatting with customer support, asking the community, emailing customer support, or calling customer support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The support channel selection interface must be intuitive, with clear icons and text descriptions for each support option, requiring no more than 2 clicks to access the chosen support method.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures easy navigation and quick access to desired support channels.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The support options must include a visual indicator of expected response time for each channel (e.g., chat - immediate, email - 24 hours, community - variable).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users make informed decisions about which support channel to use based on their urgency.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The support channel selection system must be compatible with at least three major web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) and responsive across desktop and mobile devices.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures accessibility across different platforms and devices.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The support channel system must allow for easy addition of new support channels with minimal system reconfiguration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides flexibility to expand support options in the future.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The support channel selection interface must load within 1 second and provide real-time availability status for each support option.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures a responsive and informative user experience when seeking support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The support channel selection system must be available 99.9% of the time, with clear fallback options if primary channels are unavailable.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can always access support resources when needed.
